description: This file defines the TagItemsIndex class, which manages indexing and tracking of tag-related items, including count updates, observer notifications, and handling changes in items and tags within a collection.

classes.name: TagItemsIndex
classes.description: Implements an index for managing tag-related items, including counting, observing changes, and updating internal state based on item and tag modifications.

methods.name: addCountChangeObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer for count change events and returns a function to remove it.

methods.name: allCountableItemsCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of countable items.

methods.name: allCountableNotesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of countable notes.

methods.name: allCountableFilesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of countable files.

methods.name: countableItemsForTag
methods.description: Returns the number of items associated with a specific tag.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles changes in items and tags, updating internal state accordingly.

methods.name: receiveTagChanges
methods.description: Processes tag reference updates and notifies observers if changes occur.

methods.name: receiveItemChanges
methods.description: Processes item changes, updates counts, and notifies observers of relevant updates.

methods.name: setForTag
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a set of item UUIDs associated with a specific tag.
